title: Jesus shows us something powerful in Gethsemane.
paragraphs: Jesus shows us something powerful in Gethsemane.

He didn’t pretend the cross was easy.
He asked for another way.
But He didn’t stop at the request.

Real faith isn’t silent acceptance without prayer.
And it isn’t demanding our way either.
It’s bold honesty… followed by deeper trust.

“Lord, this is what I want.
But I trust what You want more.”
Have you ever prayed for something… and God said no or not yet?
